name: shamisen
description: Jewelbox 55 Shamisen: a black-lacquer rail with gold end caps is the striker; the whole shamisen hangs upright from it on a red silk cord tied round the head - three ivory itomaki pegs, the slim dark-red shitan neck, the square drum body with bulging sides, white skin, red cloth, ivory bridge, three silk strings and the big ivory bachi resting on the skin.
